caption: The drawing shows a large ceramic jar or crock, tan or beige in color with blue decorative elements and writing. The jar has two rounded handles on either side near the top, also colored with blue accents. Near the upper center of the jar, there is a blue insignia featuring an eagle above the text “J. REMMEY / MANHATTAN-WELLS / NEW-YORK,” all in blue letters and capitals. There is a blue leafy or wing-shaped motif underneath the text and a similar blue flourish beside one handle. The jar is depicted standing upright against a pale background, possibly paper, with a faintly outlined rectangular border around it. In the lower left corner of the image, there is a simple line drawing outline of the jar, showing its basic shape and handle placement. The entire composition is rendered in watercolor and graphite, giving it a soft and realistic appearance, with the jar as the central object and no additional background elements or scenery.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
